item.title: Horsfield sticks with Majesticks for new LIV season
item.description: Sam Horsfield has re-signed with Majesticks Golf Club to complete a new-look line-up for the 2026 LIV Golf season.

item.title: SA duo through as LIV Promotions heats up
item.description: Two South Africans will carry local hopes into the second round of LIV Golf Promotions after safely negotiating the opening hurdle at Black Diamond Ranch in Florida.

item.title: RangeGoats lock in 2026 LIV roster
item.description: RangeGoats GC have confirmed contract extensions for Peter Uihlein, Matthew Wolff and Ben Campbell for the 2026 LIV Golf League season.

item.title: PGA Tour autumn schedule confirmed
item.description: Two events in Mexico and stops in Japan and Bermuda highlight the PGA Tour's eight-tournament autumn schedule.

item.title: Watch: Australian Ashes hero sinks monster putt
item.description: A mere 24 hours after Australia wrapped up a 4-1 Ashes series win, Travis Head showed his talent on the golf course by sinking a monster putt.

item.title: Saffa advances in LIV Golf Promotions
item.description: A South African remains in contention for a place on the 2026 LIV Golf League after progressing to the final weekend of LIV Golf Promotions.

item.title: Koepka applies for PGA Tour reinstatement
item.description: Brooks Koepka, who left the PGA Tour for LIV Golf in 2022 but quit the league last month, has reportedly applied for PGA reinstatement.

item.title: Bekker in hunt in LIV Golf wildcard battle
item.description: Oliver Bekker moved into a share of second place at Black Diamond Ranch in Florida heading into Sunday’s final round of the LIV Golf Promotions shootout.
